free_tier.stated: No free tier. Linux VPS 01G is USD 2.09 a month: 1 GB RAM, 1 Xeon Platinum vCore, 10 GB NVMe, 500 GB of traffic a month, native IPv6 and no IPv4 address.
free_tier.notes: The aggregator lists a 'LET-MR-2' plan at EUR 18 a year with 20 TB; no such plan is on the vendor's public pages read, and the aggregator's order link did not answer a text read, so that plan and its 20 TB are not confirmed.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a VPS, not an object store

egress.terms: 500 GB of traffic per month on a 1 Gbps port (homepage card '1 Gbps / 500 GB'); no overage price or post-cap throttle is stated on the pages read.

interface_detail: KVM Linux VPS with root access over IPv6 only; the page names no port or protocol filter.
chaining: An IPv6-only box: outbound IPv4 destinations are reachable only through a translator or proxy that the user supplies, and inbound reaches the VPS only over IPv6.

limits.value: no IPv4 address on this plan: IPv6 only

binding_note: 500 GB a month is the first number to fail; the missing IPv4 address restricts reachability but does not fail on a schedule.
